items.title: 68088_Wilbur B. Ware, Sr oral history interview
items.q: Blue Mitchell had a four-piece group. Blue had Walter Davis, Jr., myself, Al Foster and Lucky had Victor Sproles...

ctx.x: That's right. He and Richard Davis and Hal Mabern. Al made one. Billy wrote one of the tunes on that, you know.
Right. inaudible, I think it was.
